integrity_notes: Analytical all-parameter proof supplied; executable checker verifies finite exact-rational and numerical consistency assertions and does not substitute for an infinite proof. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only a two-habitat positive linear stochastic growth model with independently sampled equally likely perfectly anticorrelated binary environments is covered.
Conclusions concern the invariant ratio distribution and its support, not absolute abundance growth, population persistence, density regularity, Hausdorff dimension, or finite-sample estimation.
The zero- and full-migration endpoints and zero disperser survival are excluded; independent historical priority verification remains outstanding.
title: Sharp reentrant ratio-support transitions and dispersal duality in two-habitat stochastic growth
